site.name: KALA
site.tagline: Colour, devotion and a little chaos.
site.summary: KALA is the online studio of India-based artist Anushka Kishor: original hand-painted acrylic paintings (devotional art, dot-work mandalas, portraits and small works), hand-painted wall murals and custom painted wearables.

/.title: Original Paintings, Mandalas & Murals
/.description: KALA by Anushka Kishor: original hand-painted paintings, dot mandalas, devotional art, wall murals and painted wearables. Buy an original or commission one.
/.h1: Colour, devotion and a little chaos.

/shop.title: Shop Original Paintings Online
/shop.description: Shop KALA by Anushka Kishor: original hand-painted paintings, devotional art, mandalas and small canvases. One of each, packed by hand, free shipping in India.

/collections.title: Collections: Five Chapters of Original Art
/collections.description: Explore KALA’s five chapters by Anushka Kishor: devotional paintings, mandala studies, portraits, wall murals and small works. Open a chapter to see every piece.

/archive.title: Archive: Sold Paintings & Past Murals
/archive.description: Paintings that have found their walls and murals that stay where they were painted. Browse Anushka Kishor’s archive and commission something in the same spirit.

/walls.title: Wall Mural Artist: Hand-Painted Murals
/walls.description: KALA wall murals: hire Anushka Kishor to hand-paint a mural for your home, office, café or school in India. Mandalas, florals and custom designs.

/artist.title: About Anushka Kishor, Painter & Mural Artist
/artist.description: Anushka Kishor is the India-based artist behind KALA. She builds software by day and paints by passion: devotional art, mandalas, murals and wearables.

/commission.title: Commission a Painting, Portrait or Mural
/commission.description: Commission KALA by Anushka Kishor: a custom hand-painted painting for a room, a portrait of someone you love, a wall mural or a painted wearable.

/contact.title: Contact Anushka Kishor
/contact.description: A question about a painting, shipping, a collaboration or a commission? Write to Anushka Kishor, the artist behind KALA. Every message is read personally.

/order.title: Order an Original Painting
/order.description: Order original paintings by Anushka Kishor and pay securely with UPI, card or netbanking. Every painting is packed by the artist; free shipping in India.

/track.title: Track Your Order
/track.description: Track a KALA order with the reference from your confirmation email and the email you ordered with. No account needed.

/shipping.title: Shipping & Delivery Policy
/shipping.description: KALA ships original paintings free within India. Each painting is packed by the artist and handed to a tracked courier within 7 working days of payment.
/shipping.h1: From my hands to your wall

/returns.title: Returns, Refunds & Cancellations
/returns.description: All sales of KALA original paintings are final: no cancellations, returns or refunds after order confirmation. Transit damage reported within 48 hours is repaired or replaced.

/terms.title: Terms & Conditions
/terms.description: The terms for buying original paintings and commissioning work from KALA by Anushka Kishor: orders, payment, shipping, final sales, copyright and disputes.

/privacy.title: Privacy Policy
/privacy.description: How KALA by Anushka Kishor collects, uses, shares and protects your personal data under India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, and how to use your rights.

/cookies.title: Cookie Policy
/cookies.description: KALA sets no cookies of its own and uses no analytics or advertising trackers. Your cart lives in local storage on your device; Razorpay sets its own cookies at payment.

devotional.title: Devotional Paintings: Krishna, Radha, Ganesha & Buddha
devotional.description: Hand-painted devotional art by Anushka Kishor: Krishna and Radha, Ganesha, Shiva, Devi, Vitthal and Buddha. Original paintings to buy, enquire about or commission.

mandala.title: Mandala & Dot Art Paintings
mandala.description: Dot-work mandala paintings by Anushka Kishor, from the Om Mandala on deep ultramarine to mandala wall murals. See the series or commission your own mandala.

portraits.title: Portrait Paintings & Custom Portrait Commissions
portraits.description: Acrylic portraits and personal pieces by Anushka Kishor. See the portraits chapter, then commission a hand-painted portrait of someone you love.

murals.title: Wall Murals for Homes, Schools & Offices
murals.description: Hand-painted wall murals by Anushka Kishor: mandala murals for homes and chalkboard murals for schools and offices. See past walls and commission yours.

small.title: Small Paintings: Little Canvases & Sketchbook Art
small.description: Small, joyful originals by Anushka Kishor: a peacock, a happy cat, a little Buddha, sunflowers and sketchbook pages. Affordable original art to buy or enquire about.

krishna.title: Krishna and Radha, Original Acrylic Painting
krishna.lead: Hand-painted Krishna and Radha, acrylic on A3 (2021) in a wooden frame: cobalt-blue Krishna and Radha on warm ochre.

om.title: Om Mandala, Dot Art Acrylic Painting
om.lead: A dot-work Om mandala glowing saffron on deep ultramarine, acrylic on A4 canvas (2022) by Anushka Kishor.

child.title: Child Portrait, Original Acrylic Painting
child.lead: A sleeping child in rose, vermilion and magenta over violet, with sculpted roses: acrylic on A3 canvas (2020).

ganesha.title: Ganesha, Framed Original Acrylic Painting
ganesha.lead: A stylised Ganesha in cobalt and periwinkle with saffron and vermilion curves on black: acrylic on A3 (2020), framed.

mural.title: Mandala Wall Mural, Hand-Painted in a Home
mural.lead: A half-mandala mural in crimson, saffron, lilac and turquoise petals with teal leaves, hand-painted on a home wall (2020).

chalk.title: Think Out of the Box, Wall Mural in Bhopal
chalk.lead: A chalkboard-black mural with a lightbulb full of gears and cascading squares, hand-painted on site in Bhopal (2022).

vitthal.title: Vitthal, Original Acrylic Painting on Indigo
vitthal.lead: Vitthal with closed eyes, a saffron-and-gold crown and sunburst earrings on deep indigo: acrylic on A3 (2021).

flute.title: Flute and Veena, Framed Krishna Painting
flute.lead: A serene face with gold-beaded hair, blue Krishna with his flute and a veena, in cobalt and sky blue: acrylic, A3 (2020).

krishnachild.title: Krishna and a Child, Small Acrylic Painting
krishnachild.lead: Krishna and a child in a yellow dress lean on a railing, seen from behind on soft green: a small acrylic on A5 (2026).

escape.title: The Escape Key Exists for a Reason, Acrylic
escape.lead: A small figure climbs out of a keyboard, lifting the Esc key like a hatch: a witty acrylic painting on A4 canvas (2026).

bloom.title: Just Bloom, Painted Lotus Sketchbook Spread
bloom.lead: A saffron sketchbook spread with white lotus line drawings and “Just Bloom” in red script, painted in acrylic (2019).

radhakrishna.title: Radha and Krishna in Blue, Framed Painting
radhakrishna.lead: Radha with a crown of golden dots and a small blue Krishna with his flute, on bright blue: acrylic, A3 (2020), exhibited.

buddha.title: Buddha with Lotus, Original Acrylic on Canvas
buddha.lead: Half of a serene green Buddha face above a coral lotus on shimmering dark green: acrylic on A3 canvas (2022), signed.

sunflower.title: Sunflower, Original Acrylic Painting
sunflower.lead: A close-up sunflower, saffron and lemon petals around a dark seed head, on deep navy: acrylic on A4 (2019).

butterfly.title: Blue Butterfly, Original Acrylic Painting
butterfly.lead: A black butterfly with blue-and-white wing panels resting by blue tulips on bands of green: acrylic on A4 (2019).

elephant.title: Little Elephant, Watercolour Painting
elephant.lead: A watercolour baby elephant in blue blowing three red hearts, under a sky melting from blue to orange and pink, A3.

peacock.title: Peacock, Small Framed Acrylic Painting
peacock.lead: A royal-blue peacock with a golden beak and swirling green tail feathers on yellow: a small acrylic (2022), framed.

babybuddha.title: Little Buddha, Small Acrylic Painting
babybuddha.lead: A smiling little monk in blue robes on a pink lotus, white rays on sky blue: a small, signed acrylic painting (2023).

cat.title: Happy Cat, Acrylic Painting on Wood
cat.lead: A grinning ginger cat with a red heart nose and long whiskers on speckled cobalt blue: acrylic on wood (2024), signed.

lightning.title: Lightning, Watercolour Sketchbook Painting
lightning.lead: Branching yellow-white lightning over a smoky orange and red sky: a watercolour in an A4 sketchbook (2021).

bicycle.title: Bicycle with Flowers, Acrylic Painting
bicycle.lead: A rust-orange bicycle with a basket of white and blue flowers against a deep blue wash: acrylic on A4 (2021).

risingmandala.title: Rising Mandala, Ink and Colour Mandala Art
risingmandala.lead: Half a mandala rising into a black sky, petals washed in coral, green, teal and blue with black ink and white dots: ink and colour on A4 paper.

cactus.title: Desert Cactus, Patterned Ink Painting
cactus.lead: A patterned green-and-blue cactus on yellow and orange dunes under a huge orange sun and a magenta sky, painted in ink and colour.

ganeshablue.title: Little Ganesha in Blue, Acrylic Painting
ganeshablue.lead: A pink-and-crimson Ganesha with a yellow crown, a blessing hand and a modak, on swirling sky-blue brushstrokes: acrylic on paper (2024).

dragonfly.title: Dragonfly, Original Acrylic Painting
dragonfly.lead: A green dragonfly with pale pink wings on a tall strip fading from red and orange into teal and yellow: acrylic on paper by Anushka Kishor.

devilotus.title: Devi with Lotus, Devotional Acrylic Painting
devilotus.lead: A serene goddess in a red sari and gold jewellery rising behind a pink lotus, on a red-and-gold glow and deep blue night: acrylic on A4 (2021).

shiva.title: Shiva in Blue, Original Acrylic on Canvas
shiva.lead: Shiva in blues and violets, eyes closed, with a third eye, a crescent moon, a rudraksha mala and a serpent: acrylic on canvas by Anushka Kishor.

ganeshacolour.title: Ganesha in Colour, Abstract Acrylic Painting
ganeshacolour.lead: An abstract Ganesha in bold blocks of colour, a blue trunk, a yellow crown and a dotted yellow belly on orange and red: acrylic by Anushka Kishor.

buddhagreen.title: Buddha in Green, Original Acrylic on Canvas
buddhagreen.lead: A grey Buddha head with closed eyes behind a green lotus, white lotuses either side, on streaks of green, ochre and teal: acrylic on canvas (2023).
